title: Vision-LLM Browser Automation for Unseen Web Portals
oneLiner: Skyvern uses vision LLMs and DOM parsing to automate complex multi-step browser workflows—such as invoice downloads, government filings, and procurement forms—across unfamiliar websites without brittle XPaths.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: Skyvern uses vision LLMs and DOM parsing to automate complex multi-step browser workflows—such as invoice downloads, government filings, and procurement forms—across unfamiliar websites without brittle XPaths.
steps: Deploy Skyvern via Docker or sign in to Skyvern Cloud
Create workflow with target URL and navigation goal
configSnippet: "Log into the supplier portal, navigate to Billing History, and download all PDF invoices from last month."
limitations: Vision-based multi-step execution is slower and consumes more tokens than API or DOM-only scrapers.
